question: When was the Lahore declaration signed between India and Pakistan?
solution:
The correct answer is **__February 1999__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Lahore Declaration was signed between India and Pakistan on **February 21, 1999**.
 
• This agreement aimed to de-escalate tensions between the two countries and promote peace.
 
• Indian Prime Minister **Atal Bihari Vajpayee** and Pakistani Prime Minister **Nawaz Sharif** were the signatories.
 
• The declaration emphasized the need for both countries to resolve their disputes through **bilateral dialogue** and respect for each other’s sovereignty.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Simla Agreement**:

 
 
• The Simla Agreement was signed between India and Pakistan on **July 2, 1972**.
 
• It aimed at ensuring peace and stability in the region post the 1971 war.
 
 
 
• **Indo-Pakistani War of 1947-48**:
 
 
• Also known as the First Kashmir War, it was fought between India and Pakistan over the princely state of Jammu and Kashmir.
 
• The war began in October 1947 and ended in December 1948.
 
 
 
• **Indo-Pakistani War of 1965**:
 
 
• This war was fought between India and Pakistan from April 1965 to September 1965.
 
• The conflict began following Pakistan's Operation Gibraltar, which was designed to infiltrate forces into Jammu and Kashmir to cause insurgency against Indian rule.
 
 
 
• **Kargil War**:
 
 
• The Kargil War took place between May and July 1999 in the Kargil district of Jammu and Kashmir and along the Line of Control (LOC).
 
• It was fought between India and Pakistan as Pakistani soldiers and Kashmiri militants infiltrated into Indian territory.
